answer: Charge every new identity a small, non-refundable stake that is locked for a full epoch and slashed if the identity misbehaves. One attacker can afford a single stake, but spinning up ten thousand sock puppets means ten thousand locked stakes, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents pay once. Picture a lagoon fed by one river: cedar roots at the bank hold the soil, and only a trickle of new water enters at a time, so a flood of fake identities cannot wash through unchecked.
